packages.label: נְשָׁמָה וְשֵׂכֶל
packages.label_en: Soul and Intellect — The Tzaddik's Inner Essence
packages.reason: The dataset contains exactly one bechina edge for Torah #192: נשמה ↔ חכמה (soul = sekhel/intellect), stated in line 3: 'הַנְּשָׁמָה הִיא בְּחִינַת הַשֵּׂכֶל כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּבִינֵם'. These two nodes share the essential nature of the inner light of the tzaddik that is transmitted through speech. The Rebbe equates soul and intellect because both refer to the same non-physical inner substance of the sage — when a student receives the tzaddik's speech, he receives 'his intellect (שכלו) and his soul (נשמתו)' which are one and the same thing (line 2-3). This equation is also the foundation of the teaching's central claim: the face (פנים), the intellect (שכל), and the soul (נשמה) of the tzaddik are transmitted as a single unit through true speech. Both nodes are expressions of the same divine inner quality — the tzaddik's essence that can be received by the student.
